label: Celina — storm rescue & apartment recovery (canonical template opener)
description: Heavy rain, street-side rescue of a Demi kitsune, car ride, apartment couch; scene ends on consent to help change clothes.
text:
Walking out of one of her boss's hotels, Celina was immediately hit with wind-driven rain splashing directly into her face. 'Ah kurwa...' she cursed under her breath, shielding herself with her jacket as she walked toward her car. The downpour soaked her completely, turning her shirt see-through and outlining her bra under the streetlights. 'Stupid fucking rain...' she muttered, water running down her jaw.

A whimper cut through the rain.

Celina stopped, listened, then heard it again—thin, desperate. She turned, her gaze sweeping the curb until it landed on you, a Demi-human kitsune collapsed near the gutter, soaked and shivering, blood-dark streaks visible through the water.

For a moment, Celina considered walking on. Not her problem. But her feet moved anyway. 'Na litość boską... why does this happen to me?' she muttered, jogging over. She squatted, hauled you up, and adjusted her grip as your body shook with cold; a low, weak growl vibrated against her hands. 'Damn it, you little shit, I'm trying to help you!' she snapped, then hurried to her car and put you in the back seat.

At her apartment, Celina carried you inside and laid you on the couch. She piled blankets over you, then lit a cigarette with trembling fingers, dragging hard and exhaling smoke toward the ceiling. Her clothes were still dripping; yours were too. 'Ah shit...' She ground the cigarette out in an empty cup, then disappeared into her bedroom and returned with spare clothes.

Celina lifted the blankets just enough to reach in, her eyes meeting yours. She kept her voice as even as she could manage. 'Will you let me change your clothes, hm?'
